tasks.name: 创建博客数据模型
tasks.description: 设计并创建博客的数据模型，包括标题、描述和图片URL字段，并保存到数据库。

tasks.name: 实现图片存储功能
tasks.description: 设置图片存储机制，支持用户上传图片并将其存储在服务器或云存储中。

tasks.name: 创建博客API接口
tasks.description: 开发后端API接口，支持博客的创建、读取、更新和删除操作，并处理图片上传。

tasks.name: 设计博客前端页面
tasks.description: 设计一个明亮可爱的博客前端页面，包括博客列表和创建新博客的表单。

tasks.name: 实现博客创建功能
tasks.description: 在前端实现博客创建功能，用户可以输入标题、描述并上传图片，提交后通过API保存到后端。

tasks.name: 实现博客展示功能
tasks.description: 在前端实现博客展示功能，用户可以查看已创建的博客列表及其详细信息。

T1.implementation_approach: Define a database schema with fields like title, content, author, tags, and timestamps.
T1.notes: Consider scalability and indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Use a cloud storage service or local file system to store images and generate unique file names.
T2.notes: Ensure proper validation and size restrictions for uploaded images.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on blog posts using a backend framework.
T3.notes: Implement authentication and input validation for secure API usage.

T4.implementation_approach: Design responsive web pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks like React or Vue.
T4.notes: Focus on user-friendly navigation and mobile compatibility.

T5.implementation_approach: Create a form on the frontend to collect blog details and send data to the backend API for storage.
T5.notes: Validate user input on both frontend and backend.

T6.implementation_approach: Fetch blog data from the API and display it in a paginated or infinite scroll format on the frontend.
T6.notes: Optimize for performance and include search and filter options.
